messages:
olivia: Quick sync — I want to cut a small SDK patch for py + ts in ~2h. It includes a deprecation notice for the legacy sync client and an emergency shim for a breaking import path. Need agreement on publish tags and rollback plan.
samir: Change window ok for me, prefer we do it in the 18:00-19:00 UTC slot.
maria: Notes: update CHANGELOG, add a short migration snippet for sync->async, and include a stern deprecation header in README. I can draft.
jack: For npm I'd rather publish under an 'edge' dist-tag first, not canary, so we can mirror to npmjs and our internal mirror separately. That avoids consumers accidentally picking it up.
release-ops: Proposed flow: 1) publish to test PyPI + npm registry with tag 'edge'. 2) run smoke matrix (integration test matrix). 3) if green for 20m, promote to 'latest' and push docs. Rollback if >3 regressions across core tests in 15m.
olivia: Sounds good. For PyPI we'll upload wheels and sdist. Use twine to test upload to test.pypi.org first. For npm use --tag edge and don't touch dist-tags until promote step.
maria: Drafted the deprecation blurb: "The sync client is deprecated and will be removed in v2.0. See migration guide." Put that at top of README and in release notes.
samir: Quick question on compatibility: the shim keeps old import path but logs a WARN for 30 days, right?
jack: Yep. Implementation writes a single WARN once per process; code sample in release notes.
release-ops: Rollback mechanics: if we need to revert after promotion, we'll: a) npm dist-tag add package@<previous> latest && npm dist-tag add package@<previous> stable-mirror b) pip yanked wheel from pypi and re-promote last released wheel to 'latest' via our mirror metadata. Also open incident ticket and email customers on reserved list.
olivia: For the emergency quick-rollback we should also push a hotfix with the old client backported to a patch branch so uninstall + reinstall picks it up. That means pre-creating the rollback commit and CI job.
maria: I'll create the rollback branch now and add the TODOs in the release doc.
deploy-bot: publish-checker: starting dry-run publish to test registries for olivia/sdk v1.12.0-edge 
release-ops: Smoke matrix to run: unit, basic end-to-end against staging, small sample of high-throughput inference scenarios (latency bench), and the packaging integrity check (signatures).
samir: Also run an instrumentation test for KV cache migration — previous rollout hit a perf regression there.
jack: If any packaging signature mismatch occurs, DO NOT promote. We had a signer drift last quarter and it caused a rollback.
release-ops: Promotion criteria restated: all smoke tests green + no packaging/signature drift + 20m no critical errors in canary customers. If criteria fail -> execute rollback script (ops/rollback-scripts/promote-revert.sh).
maria: Release notes draft link: https://docs.internal/release-notes/olivia-sdk-1.12.0 (I'll fill in examples).
olivia: OK let's go. I'll start the dry-run now and post back when deploy-bot reports success/failure. :shipit:
deploy-bot: publish-checker: dry-run upload to test.pypi completed OK. npm publish --tag edge dry-run successful. Artifacts uploaded to staging mirror.
release-ops: Triggering smoke matrix now. Expect results in ~12m.
samir: Standing by for results.
jack: If we need to abort mid-promote we should have a short announce template for slack + GH issue linking to rollback ticket. I'll draft that and pin it in the release doc.
maria: Done — announce templates added.
release-ops: Smoke matrix: unit tests OK; e2e small failures (2 flaky auth tests) — investigating.
olivia: Noted. If auth flakes are infra related, we delay promotion. If packaging and core inference tests are green, we can triage.
samir: Auth flakes look like token rotation flakiness in staging, unrelated to SDK code. Ops investigating.
release-ops: After triage: core tests green, packaging fine, infra team fixed staging auth. Proceed to promote in 30m unless objections.
jack: No objections from me.
maria: Will push final release notes and deprecation header before promote.
olivia: I'll schedule the promote at 19:10 UTC. Leaving this thread open for any last-minute blockers.
deploy-bot: release-announce: promoting olivia/sdk v1.12.0-edge -> latest now. publish job started.
deploy-bot: release-announce: publish succeeded. npm dist-tags: latest -> 1.12.0 ; PyPI mirrored.
release-ops: Post-promote checks: monitoring traces for latency/kv cache anomalies, and error rate over next 30m.
samir: Looks clean on our quick traces so far. No regression in median latency.
maria: Release notes live: https://docs.redwood/release/1.12.0 and deprecation snippet included.
jack: Sending the customer notice to the reserved list now.
olivia: Great work everyone. If a rollback is needed, use the pinned rollback script and notify #incidents. Closing once 30m passes clean. :tada:
